title: Migrate Apricity-web (cut over) onto the standard front end

comments.author: home
comments.text: Code migrated and published to the candidate; cut-over blocked. Apricity-web PRs #6 and #7 (merged): web/projection.json + web/hooks.py + theme replace the SiteChrome/build_markus_site rendering in scripts/publication.py (136 -> 99 lines; +47 hooks, +24 settings). URLs now directory style (/articles/about/) because the candidate CloudFront function redirects *.html to a directory (the old build would have 404ed). Parity vs previous candidate build: 0 blocking (DOM identical on 3 pages). Candidate published with the documented publish --execute (account 712236451410 asserted) to apricity-marketing-publication-publicationbucket-2sgzw22pef9k; candidate distribution E27MARBCWWS6SV (d1z2wrz905nioh.cloudfront.net): / , /articles/about/, sitemap, robots, 404 verified. Cut-over blocked: apricity.anth.us is currently the Apricity application (CNAME to the legacy Amplify app d2n7w4kwqyfwn4 in 335163751677); the app must first move to play.apricity.anth.us (Amplify domain association and Cognito callback/logout URLs are legacy-account writes, not authorized). Then: ACM cert + alias on the candidate stack (none today) and repoint the apricity CNAME in the anth.us zone Z04979341DPRV5BDQNZMG (papyrus-production, authoritative). No Amplify app/CodeBuild project exists for Apricity-web yet.

comments.author: home
comments.text: apricity.anth.us now serves the marketing site; the application is at play.apricity.anth.us (2026-10-21 UTC). App: new Amplify domain association apricity.anth.us with subdomain play on app d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, cert validation and play CNAME in zone Z04979341DPRV5BDQNZMG (papyrus-production); app env APRICITY_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS extended (apex first, then play) and Amplify job 137 on main (same commit as job 136) redeployed so Cognito client callback and logout URLs and amplify_outputs.json include play; existing clients, providers and flows unchanged. Verified: play serves the app (200, wasm, outputs), Cognito authorize accepts the play redirect and forwards to Google; a full interactive Google sign-in was not run. Marketing: cert 8ce4ffbb-7a52-461c-9c11-28e49361e4cc, stack apricity-marketing-publication (Apricity-web PR 8), distribution E27MARBCWWS6SV; apricity.anth.us A/AAAA aliases replace the old CNAME in the new zone; old app paths 302 to play. Incident: apricity.anth.us returned 404 for several minutes during the move (the Amplify association had to be released before CloudFront would accept the alias). Old callback URL for the apex kept for now. Rollback: re-create the anth.us association with prefix apricity on the Amplify app and restore the CNAME to d2jjrpf0iybapo.cloudfront.net.
